rationale: Under the pik_le_interest_rate all-in convention, interest_rate must include the PIK leg. The source rows for AMEX Holding III show reference spread/floor values of 3M SOFR + 5.50% / 1.00% and 3M SOFR + 6.65% / 1.00%, while the Cash Interest Rate / PIK Rate column shows 0.00% cash / 9.99% PIK. The flagged stored interest_rate is the reference spread, not the all-in PIK-inclusive coupon, so pik_rate exceeds interest_rate because the extractor kept the wrong rate field.
